# Guide Package Conventions

## Rules

- Hexagonal layers, one-way imports only:
  - `domain/` — entities, value objects, domain errors, domain services. MUST NOT import `application/`, `infrastructure/`, `composition/`.
  - `application/` — use-case interactors, queries, driven ports (interfaces). Depends only on `domain/`. MUST NOT import `infrastructure/`, `composition/`.
  - `infrastructure/` — driven adapters implementing application ports (static pre-bundled catalog storage; in-memory BM25 search with `minisearch`). Depends on `domain/` + `application/`.
  - `composition/` — DI factories, composition root, unified engine facade `createGuideEngine()`.
  - Root exports `src/index.ts`, `src/public.ts`: public facade, domain types, typed error classes.
- Standalone: MUST NOT declare runtime dependency on `@specd/core`, `@specd/cli`, `@specd/mcp` (dependencies + peerDependencies).
  - Self-contained; MUST run in lightweight hosts (CI runners, client CLI binaries, MCP server processes) without SpecD kernel, AST parsers, delta engines, schema validators.
  - Markdown frontmatter + heading parsing for bundling MUST occur strictly at build time; no runtime AST parsing overhead.
- Error hierarchy under `domain/errors/` (per `guide:errors`):
  - All domain errors MUST extend `SpecdGuideError`, implementing SpecD Error Contract (`specd = true`, `code: string`) without importing `@specd/core`. Inherits native `Error` directly. `code` non-empty `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`; `message` human-readable.
  - `GuideTopicNotFoundError`, `GuideSectionNotFoundError` MUST be thrown by application queries, handled gracefully by delivery adapters.
- `packages/guide/` MUST provide standard monorepo config/assets:
  - `package.json` — name `@specd/guide`, `type` `module`, scripts `build`, `test`, `lint`, clean dependency declarations. Manifest MUST target `dist/`.
  - `tsconfig.json` — matches monorepo compiler settings.
  - `vitest.config.ts` — Vitest test config.
  - `test/` — comprehensive unit + integration suite covering domain models, queries, adapters, composition facade.
- `packages/guide/README.md` MUST be detailed, high quality, documenting:
  - Overview, motivation, zero-runtime-core-dependency design.
  - Architecture diagram of hexagonal layers (`domain/`, `application/`, `infrastructure/`, `composition/`) — ASCII or Mermaid.
  - Catalog of pre-bundled guide topics.
  - Quick start: initialize `createGuideEngine()`, invoke queries.
  - Data schema reference: `GuideTopic`, `GuideSection`, `GuideOutline`, `GuideSearchHit`, `GuideSummary`.

## Constraints

- Zero runtime dependencies on `@specd/core`.
- Monorepo package conventions observed across all directories and files.
- All line numbers across the package MUST be 1-indexed.
- No spec dependencies — this is a global constraint spec.
- ⚠ drift: verify asserts `package.json` `main` + `types` point at `dist/`; code declares neither (exports-only convention). Exports map is `.` → `./dist/public.js` and `./internal` → `./dist/index.js`.
- ⚠ gap: no scenario pins README topic catalog to bundled catalog; `templates` listed in README is not a real topic.
